photos.name: cheese-basil-slice-side-crumb
photos.summary: Side view of cheese-and-basil slice (#3) — open, airy interior with large irregular holes throughout the crust. Best fermentation bubbles of the four.

photos.name: cheese-basil-slice-top-scorched
photos.summary: Top view of cheese-and-basil slice (#3) — browned mozzarella with scorched basil leaf from overcooked broiler. Good crumb visible along the cornicione.

photos.name: dough-ball-after-turnout
photos.summary: Shaped dough ball resting on the countertop after turnout — smooth, taut surface with the glass mixing bowl visible behind it.

photos.name: dough-on-scale-weighing
photos.summary: Bulk dough in a metal bowl on an OXO digital scale — bubbly, fermented surface showing good activity before dividing into 4 balls.

photos.name: jalapeno-pepperoni-slice-side
photos.summary: Side profile of jalapeño pepperoni slice (#4) — thin, crispy base with visible jalapeño rings and even crumb structure. Not much rise, possibly overproofed.

photos.name: jalapeno-pepperoni-slice-top
photos.summary: Top view of jalapeño pepperoni slice (#4) — flat pepperoni slices, sliced jalapeño rings, melted cheese with browning.

photos.name: jalapeno-pepperoni-whole-wire-rack
photos.summary: Whole jalapeño pepperoni pizza (#4) cooling on a wire rack — generous pepperoni coverage with scattered jalapeño slices, leopard-spotted charring on the cornicione.

photos.name: pepperoni-slice-side-crumb
photos.summary: Side view of pepperoni slice (#1) showing the crumb — open, well-aerated crust tapering to a thin crispy center.

photos.name: sauce-pizza-on-steel-close
photos.summary: Sauce-only pizza (#2) on the baking steel inside the oven — dough puffing up around the edges, mis-launched but recovering mid-bake.

photos.name: sauce-pizza-overhead-dark
photos.summary: Overhead shot of sliced sauce-and-basil pizza (#2) — mix of square and wedge cuts, charred basil leaves scattered across bright red sauce, no cheese.

photos.name: sauce-pizza-piece-crumb-closeup
photos.summary: Closeup of sauce pizza (#2) slice lifted to show the crumb — open, airy interior despite the failed launch. Charred basil on top.
